# BAD-075 — Re-anchor the collab handlers' now-cross-file 'above'/'below' comment references

## Brief
BAD-047's PR 2 is a pure move, so every comment inside a moved block had to travel byte-for-byte — and several of them navigate by position in a file that no longer holds what they point at. lifecycle.ts:65 says the guarded UPDATE works 'exactly like the commit path's fallback stamp below'; that stamp is now push.ts:170, and what is actually below it in lifecycle.ts is wrapRoom. push.ts:163 says 'the gun itself is the host's Start (mode start above)', which is lifecycle.ts:68. room.ts:76 calls the phase-aware expiry 'shared by every gate below', and the gates are now spread over six sibling files. Each is a true statement about a file that no longer exists, and a reader following one lands somewhere unrelated. Same shape as BAD-049's re-point of the web-api comments and BAD-054's vestigial banners: cheap, mechanical, and impossible to do inside the move itself without breaking the body diff that is the move's whole proof.

Evidence: grep -n 'below|above' over the six new modules, run after pass 3 landed: lifecycle.ts:65 'path''s fallback stamp below' (target: push.ts commitUpload, the isHost guarded UPDATE); push.ts:163 "mode 'start' above" (target: lifecycle.ts startRoom); room.ts:76 'shared by every gate below' (targets: info.ts, seats.ts, lifecycle.ts, push.ts, pull.ts). Three more read correctly and must be left alone because their referent moved with them: room.ts:19 and room.ts:53 (both within room.ts), info.ts:108 (within roomInfo), lifecycle.ts:146 (within closeRoom), pull.ts:15 ('sits below the membership gate', still true of the dispatch order). The spike's section 7 comment list covers only references from OUTSIDE the function; these are inside the moved bodies and so were out of scope for every pass of PR 2.
